description:
Record that one lot was made from another, so a recall can follow the material. Adds an event to both
lots' histories. Manufacturers only.

child_lot.description: The lot that was made from it
child_lot.title: Child Lot

location.description: Where it happened, e.g. 'Plant 2, Port Huron MI'
location.title: Location

parent_lot.description: The lot that was used up (material, component)
parent_lot.title: Parent Lot

quantity.description: How much of the parent went in, e.g. '400 kg'
quantity.title: Quantity

name: chainflow_link_lots
title: ChainFlow: link a lot to what it was made from
